loadError.title: Quotes did not load
loadError.text: Could not get the data. Please try again.

unavailable.title: Document flow is not responding
unavailable.text: The documents service is temporarily unavailable. Nothing is lost — try again shortly.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.text: The "Quotes for approval" section is not available to your role.

notGranted.title: No access to document flow
notGranted.text: Your account has not been added to document flow yet. Write to the administrator.

notFound.title: Quote not found
notFound.text: There is no such quote, or your role cannot see it.

list.subtitle: Quotes waiting for the director's approval. Nothing goes to the client without a decision.
list.caption: Quotes for approval
list.select: Show quote {{number}} in the side panel

mine.title: No quotes on your step
mine.text: They arrive from ERP when costing is ready and all visas are collected. Sending to the client is impossible without the director's approval.

all.title: No quotes yet
all.text: When costing is ready and visas are collected, the quote will appear here.

card.title: {{number}}
card.readOnlyHint: Approval belongs to the director. You see the quote without internal fields.
card.noLines: The quote lines were not received from ERP: no data, no access, or ERP already has another revision of the quote. The snapshot total is shown.

internal.title: Internal data
internal.note: The client will get a PDF without these fields.

card.mismatch: The total in ERP ({{erp}}) differs from the snapshot total ({{snapshot}}): the quote changed after it was sent for approval. Refresh the card or ask the estimator.
card.clientCommentsHint: The client writes them in the cabinet while the quote awaits a decision. Reply in Chats or with a new quote version.

delivery.title: Sending to the client

state.ready: The quote is approved and not yet sent to the client.
state.sent: The quote is sent to the client.
state.closed: The client answered the quote, there is nothing more to send.

status.pending: handed to the mail service, no result yet

reason.no_telegram: the contact is not connected to the Telegram bot
reason.client_not_in_crm: the client was not passed to CRM, the bot does not know them
reason.no_cabinet: the client is not invited to the cabinet — invite them from the client card
reason.no_email: the contact has no e-mail — add it on the client card
reason.mail_not_configured: email is not set up — Settings · Connections · Email
reason.mail_failed: the email did not go out
reason.below_floor: the margin is below the minimum, a justification is needed
reason.not_claimed: the quote has no seller company
reason.no_recipient: the request has no client contact

delivery.doneEmail: The quote email is handed to the mail service — the result will appear in the report.
delivery.invalid: The quote can no longer be sent — the card is refreshed.

openReadOnly.title: The quote awaits the director's decision
openReadOnly.text: Approval and return for rework belong to the director. You see the quote without cost and margin.

approved.title: Quote approved
approved.text: The decision is made and the outgoing number is assigned. The quote goes to the client through the chosen available channels; what went out and what did not is in the "Sending to the client" report on the quote card.

returned.title: Quote returned for rework
returned.text: Assignees received the task again. A new version will come for approval after costing.

rejected.title: Quote rejected
rejected.text: The decision on the quote is made and closed.

checklist.margin: Margin not below the resolution threshold
checklist.lateNote: The quote was ready after the costing due date ({{due}}). You can approve: the journal will note "approved late".

blocked.generic: Approval is not available right now.
blocked.noData: No quote data from ERP — refresh the card.

channels.hint: The quote without internal fields goes to the client right after approval through the chosen channels.
channels.unknown: ERP did not answer, channel availability is unknown: ERP checks it on sending and shows an unavailable channel in the quote card report.

reason.no_telegram: Unavailable: the contact is not connected to the Telegram bot.
reason.client_not_in_crm: Unavailable: the client was not passed to CRM, the bot does not know them.
reason.no_cabinet: Unavailable: the client is not invited to the cabinet.
reason.no_email: Unavailable: the contact has no e-mail.
reason.mail_not_configured: Unavailable: email is not set up — Settings · Connections · Email.

consequence.title: What will happen
consequence.step1: The quote gets an outgoing number.
consequence.step2: The quote goes to the client right away through the chosen channels ({{channels}}) that are available; an unavailable channel is shown with the reason on the quote card and the request manager is notified. The client gets a PDF without cost and margin.
consequence.step2None: No channels chosen: the quote stays "Ready to send" and the request manager sends it from the quote card.
consequence.step3: Nothing goes to the client until the quote is sent; the validity period and the reminder start after sending.

other.title: Return for rework
other.commentHint: Required to return the quote: assignees will see it in the task.
other.disabled: The button is inactive until there is a comment.

reasons.route_closed: the quote was already decided by another director or replaced by a new version, the card is refreshed
reasons.checklist_not_green: the checklist is not complete ({{items}}), the card is refreshed
reasons.checklist_not_green_plain: the checklist is not complete, the card is refreshed
reasons.not_your_step: it is not your step now
reasons.eds_not_granted: you are not added to document flow
reasons.forbidden: the action is not available to your role
reasons.unavailable: the documents service is not responding, what you typed stays in the form
reasons.unknown: something went wrong, what you typed stays in the form
